SanaaTowers.meta-description: The new Sana'a Towers residential project consists of two towers located in the 50 Street district of the capital, Sana'a. Tower A includes five different types of residential apartments with structurally earthquake-resistant designs, modern luxury, spacious interiors, and practical implementation, including satellite networks and individual water and electricity meters for each apartment. Tower B includes five smaller, more economical models with the same high-quality designs and a compatible residential community.

Alhathaa-Towers.meta-description: The Al-Hathaa Towers project is a residential development located in the Al-Hathaa district of Sana'a, Yemen. The project includes two towers, each with 12 floors, and a total of 120 apartments. The towers are designed to be earthquake-resistant and feature modern amenities, including a gym, a swimming pool, and a security system. The project is currently under construction and is expected to be completed in 2025.
